Module app
Package app.model

Class SQLitePlantDAO

java.lang.Object
app.model.SQLitePlantDAO
All Implemented Interfaces:
IPlantDAO
public class SQLitePlantDAO extends Object implements IPlantDAO
SQLitePlantDAO is an implementation of the IPlantDAO interface that interacts with the application's SQLite database.
